parsed_json.up: Select all exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human androgen receptor CHEMBL1871. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1871. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Join docs on activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Filter for standard_type IC50 and exact values (standard_relation = '='). Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
